items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Don Costa is the only one that I know of.

ctx.x: Who, can you think of a songwriter that you like that works from the guitar? I mean most of those guys played the piano.
That’s right. And I can’t remember the name now — Costa. Don Costa, who wrote a lot for Sinatra.
